meta_description: JEC Plumbing and Heating offer expert plumbing and heating services across Leicester. Fast response, quality workmanship, free quotes. Call 07814 152929 today.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Plumber — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Leaking pipes, boiler trouble, or no hot water? JEC respond fast so your home is safe and comfortable again.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full heating installations, JEC Plumbing and Heating cover every domestic need across Leicester and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Supply and installation of energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers, tailored to your home's requirements. We handle the full process from survey to commissioning, leaving you with reliable heat and hot water.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing to keep your system running safely and efficiently, reducing the risk of costly breakdowns. Our engineers diagnose and fix faults quickly, restoring your heating without delay.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installations, upgrades, and power flushes to improve system performance and efficiency. Whether you're fitting radiators or replacing pipework, we deliver a clean, long-lasting result.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and loss of water pressure dealt with promptly to prevent damage to your property. We aim to attend Leicester callouts as quickly as possible, day or night.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fitting services including suite installation, tiling prep, and all associated plumbing connections. We work neatly and efficiently, minimising disruption to your home throughout the project.

services.title: General Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, leaking radiators, faulty valves, and blocked drains all handled by an experienced local plumber. No job is too small — we take pride in getting every repair right first time.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's a dripping tap or a full installation.
about_para_1: JEC Plumbing and Heating is a Leicester-based business serving homeowners across the city and surrounding communities, including Glenfield, Braunstone, and Oadby. Founded by an experienced local engineer, the company has built a steady reputation on honest pricing, reliable attendance, and quality workmanship. We are fully insured and committed to meeting all relevant industry standards on every job we undertake.
about_para_2: What sets JEC apart is straightforward professionalism — we turn up when we say we will, explain the work clearly, and leave your home tidy. Our customers come back to us because they know the job will be done properly without hidden charges or unnecessary upselling. That word-of-mouth trust is the foundation our business is built on.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About JEC Plumbing & Heating

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Had a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink and JEC came out the same day. The engineer was polite, worked quickly, and the price was very fair. Would highly recommend to anyone in Leicester.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and a new thermostat fitted. Really professional job — the engineer explained everything clearly and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. Will definitely be using JEC again for our annual service.
reviews.author: Mark H.

reviews.text: Called JEC after our heating stopped working on one of the coldest nights of the year. They came out quickly and had it sorted within the hour. Genuinely impressive response and a really reasonable charge. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Diane S.
